children: Boxlight advanced its financing plans with a new $850,000 Series E preferred stock investment from J.J. Astor & Co., supported by registration rights and consents from existing Series D holders. The company also amended its Series D Securities Purchase Agreement to align with updated preferred terms and facilitate the Series E issuance. Proceeds are earmarked for general corporate purposes, including working capital and potential acquisitions, while the company agreed to limits on new issuances, indebtedness, and variable-rate deals. The registration rights set near-term filing and effectiveness deadlines, with liquidated damages for delays.

: Shakawe Capital, ClearThink Capital Partners, Secure Net Capital
: Facilitate preferred stock amendments and enable Series E financing
Agreement 2: Boxlight Raises $850,000 via Series E Preferred Sale to J.J. Astor
: Securities Purchase Agreement (Series E Preferred Stock)
: Raise capital for working capital and potential acquisitions
Agreement 3: Boxlight Grants Registration Rights for Series E Conversion Shares to J.J. Astor
: Provide resale registration for Series E conversion shares
Agreement 4: Series D Holders Consent to Boxlight’s Series E Financing and Waive MFN Protections
: Consent, Waiver and Ratification (Series D Holders)
: Permit Series E financing and related registrations
